title: mtls_auth plugin config
description: The `config` object of an enabled `mtls_auth` plugin, generated from ferrum-edge/ferrum-edge openapi.yaml at v0.9.21 (f9915358c8032214f4034a17c28cdf72d14006c3), component MtlsAuthConfig and every component it references. Do not edit: run ci/plugin_config_schemas.py. This is Edge's own configuration schema, governed by Edge's support policy (docs/versioning.md); the plugin catalog records when Edge requires it.

MtlsAuthConfig.description: Plugin: mtls_auth — Authenticates client certificates on HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, HTTP/3, gRPC, WebSocket, terminated TCP+TLS, and UDP+DTLS. Null or an empty object uses defaults (`cert_field: subject_cn`). Stream proxies require frontend_tls=true and passthrough=false.

cert_field.description: Certificate field to use as identity. For subject_cn, subject_ou, subject_o, san_dns, and san_email Ferrum uses only the first matching value in certificate order. DNS SAN matching is ASCII case-insensitive; every other field uses exact matching.

cn.description: Issuer CN filter. Surrounding whitespace is trimmed; the trimmed value must contain a non-whitespace character.

o.description: Issuer O filter. Surrounding whitespace is trimmed; the trimmed value must contain a non-whitespace character.

ou.description: Issuer OU filter. Surrounding whitespace is trimmed; the trimmed value must contain a non-whitespace character.

ca_certificate_pem.description: Required for every allowed_issuers entry. Must contain exactly one currently valid PEM-encoded CA certificate with basicConstraints CA:TRUE and keyUsage keyCertSign. Ferrum verifies the leaf signature path through any presented intermediates to this pinned key; DN labels alone never authorize an issuer. The pin may be an intermediate or a higher-level root. A root issuer pin can succeed when the client omits that certificate from the presented chain. UDP+DTLS uses the same leaf-first verified presented chain as terminated TCP+TLS. The earliest notAfter on the path that satisfied the constraint is composed into the request and stream authorization deadline, so an issuer expiring before the leaf ends the authorization at its own expiry; across alternative verified paths the longest-lived matching path wins.

allowed_issuers.description: Per-proxy issuer pins. DN fields are descriptive filters (AND within an entry, OR across entries) and must match the pinned CA subject; the certificate signature path must also reach ca_certificate_pem. DN strings are trimmed; whitespace-only cn/o/ou values are rejected.

allowed_ca_fingerprints_sha256.description: SHA-256 fingerprints of allowed verified, client-presented intermediate/CA certificates. Matching uses the leaf-first presented chain on HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, HTTP/3, gRPC, WebSocket, terminated TCP+TLS, and UDP+DTLS. The leaf is never a CA fingerprint candidate; the corresponding CA certificate must be presented. Surrounding whitespace is trimmed before hex decoding; uppercase and lowercase hex are accepted.
